title: Nimble American Savoy Cabbage Omelette
description: A dense yet light American breakfast that blends savory savoy cabbage with a fluffy omelette, perfect for a quick high-protein start.
instructions: Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper in a bowl until the mixture is light and foamy.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the chopped cabbage and sauté for 2 minutes until it begins to soften.
Pour the egg mixture over the cabbage, letting it set for 1 minute before gently stirring.
Sprinkle grated cheddar and green onion over the semi-set eggs.
Continue cooking, lifting the edges with a spatula, until the egg is fully set but still moist, about 3 minutes.
Fold the omelette in half and slide onto a plate, allowing the cheese to melt slightly.
Serve immediately, optionally adding a squeeze of lemon or a dash of hot sauce.
